bibl.title: Pindaro e i poeti di Sparta arcaica: un frammento pindarico in POxy 2389?
bibl.seg: Marco Recchia, Pindaro e i poeti di Sparta arcaica: un frammento pindarico in POxy 2389?
bibl.note: P. Oxy. XXIV, 2389 (= MP3 81; LDAB 180). - Supports Edgar Lobel's assumption that the poetic quotation in l. 8-10, containing the name of Alcman, belongs to Pindar: the latter was familiar with Spartan poets, and the fragment reveals features which seem to be clearly pindaric.
